added: When you turn on reusable venue records, or add a venue, the app offers to link earlier programs whose typed venue matches it, so calling history counts a typed "Grange" and a saved "Grange" as one hall. The typed text is kept, and programs in Recently deleted are left as they were.

`ProgramRepository.linkTypedVenues` and `countTypedVenuePrograms` link live programs that carry a venue only as typed text to a venue record, matching by `VenueKey` and stamping each linked program for Device Sync.
